ShaderNodePreset.Description: Two-input whip pan and zoom transition with directional slide or radial zoom motion blur.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Greg Whip Pan

Uniform.Tooltip: Animate from 0 to 1 to move from Clip A to Clip B.
Uniform.Name: progress

Uniform.Tooltip: Motion direction for the transition. Choose Zoom for a radial blur zoom instead of a slide whip.
Uniform.Name: direction

Uniform.Tooltip: How far each clip travels, measured as a fraction of frame width or height.
Uniform.Name: travel

Uniform.Tooltip: Length of directional motion blur at the center of the transition.
Uniform.Name: motion_blur

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of blur samples. Higher values are smoother but slower.
Uniform.Name: blur_samples

Uniform.Tooltip: Radial motion blur strength when Direction is set to Zoom.
Uniform.Name: zoom_amount

Uniform.Tooltip: Scale the outgoing clip reaches at the end of a Zoom transition. Values above 1.0 push into the outgoing shot.
Uniform.Name: outgoing_zoom_scale

Uniform.Tooltip: Scale the incoming clip starts from in a Zoom transition. Values below 1.0 make the second input begin farther back in Z space.
Uniform.Name: incoming_zoom_scale

Uniform.Tooltip: Duration of the blend between Clip A and Clip B around the midpoint.
Uniform.Name: blend_width

Uniform.Tooltip: Blend between a plain dissolve/slide and the full whip-pan treatment.
Uniform.Name: mix_amount

Uniform.Tooltip: Mirror pixels beyond the frame edge. In Zoom mode, turn Fill Gaps off to mirror the scaled shot instead of filling with the full-frame shot.
Uniform.Name: mirror_edges

Uniform.Tooltip: Fill off-frame areas. In slide directions this uses the opposite clip; in Zoom mode this fills scaled edges with the same shot full-frame.
Uniform.Name: fill_gaps

Uniform.Tooltip: Ease Progress so the transition starts slowly, accelerates through the middle, and slows into the end.
Uniform.Name: easy_ease

Uniform.Tooltip: Bypass the plain mix contribution and show only the moving blurred result.
Uniform.Name: show_motion_only
